from.description: Start of the time range as an ISO 8601 date string.

to.description: End of the time range as an ISO 8601 date string.

bucketSize.description: The bucket size for aggregating events (e.g. "1m", "1h").

query.description: Query string to filter significant events on metadata fields

searchMode.description: Search mode: keyword (BM25), semantic (vector), or hybrid (RRF). When omitted, defaults to hybrid with a silent keyword fallback on failure. When set explicitly, failures propagate as errors.
